name: ColorSpace
brief: Enumeration specifying the methods of combining the 8-bit color channels into 32-bit color.

members.name: ABGR8888
members.brief: The channels are joined in the order: alpha, blue, green, red. Colors are alpha-premultiplied.

members.name: ARGB8888
members.brief: The channels are joined in the order: alpha, red, green, blue. Colors are alpha-premultiplied.

members.name: ABGR8888S
members.brief: The channels are joined in the order: alpha, blue, green, red. Colors are un-alpha-premultiplied.

members.name: ARGB8888S
members.brief: The channels are joined in the order: alpha, red, green, blue. Colors are un-alpha-premultiplied.

members.name: Grayscale8
members.brief: Single channel, 1 byte per pixel 8-bit grayscale.

members.name: Unknown
members.brief: Unknown channel data. This is reserved for an initial ColorSpace value.
